inputs: Frozen v3 reconstructed peer predictions and MUSA archived production predictions; no new target definitions or market recalibration
calendar_cutoffs: Quarter-end comparison requires publication strictly before quarter-end; final pre-report checkpoint requires publication strictly before MUSA report date. Date-only sources cannot be used on report day
calendar_selection: Latest published fiscal period with positive target-quarter overlap per peer; preserve actual overlap days, source hashes, basis and period endpoints
calendar_correction: Ridge alpha10 on both peer surprises; half strength; require 8 earlier MUSA residual rows with a complete peer pair in the same regime, their outcomes strictly published before current cutoff
calendar_training_features: Earlier rows use their own checkpoint, not current hindsight peer selection; forecast fit never uses own actual
factor_observations: Peer own-basis reported-minus-market-model surprises and earlier MUSA production residuals, only released before cutoff. Monthly interval weights are calendar-day exposure proxies, not gallons
factor_structure: 24 monthly states ending in cutoff month, unit positive shared loading plus separate CASY/ATD/MUSA offsets; no absolute margin pooling
factor_eligibility: At least 8 earlier same-regime published MUSA residuals overall, at least4 fully window-contained observations for each peer, at least1 published peer observation overlapping target; use only same-regime-start-window observations
factor_training: Penalized linear Gaussian latent factor; states reconstructed at each information cutoff using already published reports only. No target MUSA actual, full-history smoothing or learned loadings
regimes: pre2020 low-margin, 2020 transition, 2021 onward modern; no blind pooling
diagnostics: All eligible quarters; original >=5c production misses descriptive only; post-quarter peer sign hit rate exploratory and never an activation gate
promotion: Existing MAE/RMSE/directional/recent-eight/paired improvement gate; no retuning or automatic promotion
